description: Cyclotomic Habiro coefficients a_m(u) of tr_M(T_w, q) for atomic braids A = 2..6 via the markov_peel symbolic-q pipeline (vs the original habiro_coefficients_atomic.py Hoefsmit-symbolic pipeline which was intractable for A ≥ 3). Each row contains the full integer expansion p(u) = Σ_m a_m(u) · (u; u)_m together with D(u) (the Markov-normalisation denominator, factored) and verification that every a_m has integer coefficients (the cyclotomic integrality witness).  Resolves the D(u) blocker noted in habiro-coefficients-interpolate.witness.json.
